source: Sunpride Sales_Automation_Feature_Block_Wave_Mapping V2.xlsx (sheet List) and Phase 1 delivery-approach deck; statuses from the 2026-10-20 gap analysis

waves.name: Foundation and Master Data
exit: Outlet master deduplicated and 98% geocoded within 50 m in the pilot territory
SAP interface catalogue signed and round-trip tested in QA
Offline client runs a full 12-hour trip and syncs with no manual fix
BIR Permit to Use application filed and acknowledged
Non-functional targets signed by IT and Commercial

waves.name: Route Sales Closed Loop
exit: One depot and about 10 vans live for 4 consecutive weeks
Settlement variance under 0.5% of van sales value
Zero manual re-keying into SAP
Invoice accepted by BIR under the Permit to Use
Over 95% of trips run with no parallel paper process

waves.name: Coverage and Availability
waves.owner: VP Sales and Trade Marketing Head
exit: Universe, covered and billed universe reported daily and reconciling
PJP adherence above 85% for 4 consecutive weeks
OSA measured on 100% of MSL lines in the pilot territory
Mock-location incidents below 0.5% of check-ins
Sales leadership runs the weekly review from the cockpit, not from spreadsheets

waves.name: Channel Extension
waves.owner: VP Sales and Key Accounts Head
exit: Pre-sell to delivery within SLA, with ePOD on 98% of drops
MT PO intake automated for accounts covering 80% of MT volume
Perfect store score published weekly by account
Freezer register reconciled to the fixed asset ledger
Agency billing paid from system evidence, not agency reports

waves.name: Distributors and Secondary Sales
waves.owner: VP Sales and Channel Development Head
exit: Distributors covering 80% of indirect volume on the ordering portal and daily stock declaration
Secondary sales live for the largest distributors and reconciling to primary within tolerance
Days of inventory in trade reported weekly
Distributor rep call data flows into the same coverage cockpit

waves.name: Trade Promotions and Claims
exit: 100% of trade spend committed through the promotion master
Claims settled against captured evidence, with a measured rejection rate
Promotion ROI reported within 30 days of campaign close
Deduction ageing under control, each item with a named owner

waves.name: Control Tower and Intelligence
waves.months: Thin reporting with each wave from month 5; hardened last
exit: One agreed definition per KPI, published and enforced
Field, sales leadership and finance run from the same numbers
Supply Chain accepts the demand signal into the S&OP cycle

waves.name: Retail Store POS (conditional)
exit: Gate to start: business case approved, showing store count, store revenue and the cost of the current process

features.name: SAP interface catalogue and contract
features.description: Enumerate every interface: master data outbound, order inbound, invoice posting, credit check, stock, credit memo.
features.now: A draft list of SAP links and sample message formats; not yet agreed with your SAP team.
features.next: Write the full SAP interface list and message formats, prove them against a test SAP, then sign off with your IT.

features.name: API gateway and middleware layer
features.description: Single mediation point between field platform and SAP.
features.now: Our server has no single SAP gateway yet; credit and stock value are worked out locally.
features.next: Build one SAP gateway that every app goes through; SAP decides prices, credit and stock value.

features.name: Idempotency, replay and conflict resolution
features.description: Client transaction IDs, server-side dedupe, replay queue and deterministic conflict rules so a retry never duplicates a posting.
features.now: Phones never post the same transaction twice to our server; the SAP side lacks the same guarantee.
features.next: Give every SAP posting a fixed key so a retry can never create a second SAP document.

features.name: Delta sync engine
features.description: Push master data changes to devices incrementally.
features.now: Phones download changes since their last sync; some master changes still force a full reload.
features.next: Send small change-only updates for products, prices, outlets, routes and MSL lists.

features.name: Integration error and exception console
features.description: Operational view of failed posts, stuck queues and rejected records, with retry, reassign and escalate.
features.now: SAP errors are recorded, but the office screen still says “Not connected yet”.
features.next: An office screen to see, retry, assign and escalate every failed SAP message.

features.name: Offline-first client framework
features.description: Local encrypted store, background sync agent, queue, camera, GPS, Bluetooth printer, app update channel.
features.now: Both Android apps work fully offline with encrypted storage, but field and van run separate call steps.
features.next: One call-flow engine that both apps use, with van, field and later channels as settings.

features.name: SSO, RBAC and device binding
features.description: Single sign-on, role-based visibility down the hierarchy, one active device per user, remote wipe.
features.now: Role-based access and device registration work; sign-in is our own email and password.
features.next: Add sign-in through your company login (SSO) and enforce one registered phone per user.

features.name: Field hierarchy master
features.description: Rep, supervisor, area manager, regional manager, national.
features.now: The sales hierarchy, positions and reporting lines are set up and editable.
features.next: Keep it; load your confirmed roster and job titles when you send them.

features.name: Geography and territory master
features.description: Region, area, territory, zone with polygon or postcode definition.
features.block: Geography, Territory, Route and Beat Master
features.now: Territories exist with map boundaries; no separate region, area and zone layers.
features.next: Add region, area, territory and zone layers with map boundaries and a map editor.

features.name: Route and beat master
features.description: Route, beat, day-of-week cycle, van or rep assignment, start and end point, expected outlet count and travel distance.
features.block: Geography, Territory, Route and Beat Master
features.now: Routes with weekday plans and effective-dated rep assignments.
features.next: Add start and end depot, expected stops, distance and a versioned beat cycle.

features.name: Outlet census and geocoding drive
features.description: Physical field exercise to capture every outlet: name, address, GPS to under 50m, storefront photo, owner contact, channel, estimated class.
features.now: New outlets can be enrolled with photo and pin, but pin accuracy is not recorded.
features.next: A quick offline census mode with GPS accuracy, plus the census field plan for your survey crews.
features.laneWhen: Wave A, started 20 Oct (Masters: census mode; Programme: field plan)

features.name: Outlet master object and deduplication
features.description: Canonical outlet record.
features.now: One outlet record, separate from the SAP customer; no duplicate check.
features.next: Flag likely duplicate outlets by name, address and distance, and merge them with a review.

features.name: Channel and sub-channel taxonomy
features.description: One channel taxonomy across MT, GT sari-sari, groceries, wet market, food service, HORECA and institutional.
features.now: Channel and sub-channel are typed in as free text.
features.next: A controlled channel list with codes, picked from a menu everywhere.
features.laneWhen: Wave A, started 20 Oct (Masters, used by Availability)

features.name: Outlet classification model
features.description: Class A/B/C/D by revenue potential, not just current revenue.
features.now: Outlet class can be typed in, with an optional potential value.
features.next: Class rules and thresholds that score each outlet, with history of every change.
features.laneWhen: Wave A, started 20 Oct (Masters, used by Availability)

features.name: Product, pack and UOM master replication
features.description: Read-only replication of SAP material master: SKU, pack hierarchy, case-to-piece conversion, shelf life, storage condition, status.
features.block: Product, Pack, Price and MSL Master
features.now: Products, units and barcodes are created in our office screens, not received from SAP.
features.next: Receive products, packs and units from SAP, with the SAP version and dates kept.

features.name: Price and condition master replication
features.description: Base price, channel price lists, customer-specific conditions, tax, effective dates.
features.block: Product, Pack, Price and MSL Master
features.now: Price lists by channel are kept in our system and edited in the office.
features.next: Receive prices and conditions from SAP; our system keeps a dated copy for offline use.

features.name: MSL framework definition
features.description: Structure and maintenance screens for Must Stock Lists by channel, sub-channel and outlet class.
features.block: Product, Pack, Price and MSL Master
features.now: Must-stock lists can be set per outlet and drive shelf checks.
features.next: MSL sets by channel and class, with versions and outlet exceptions.
features.laneWhen: Wave A, started 20 Oct (Masters, used by Availability)

features.name: BIR CAS and Permit to Use track
features.description: Regulatory workstream to secure BIR CAS accreditation and Permit to Use before any document is issued.
features.now: Van receipts carry a “not a BIR official receipt” notice; no filing tracker.
features.next: Your tax team files with BIR; we add a register to track the filing and keep the notice until approved.

features.name: Document series and serial number control
features.description: Controlled, gapless, non-reusable series per van, per branch and per document type.
features.now: Receipt numbers are per trip and phone, not controlled document series.
features.next: Controlled number series per branch, van and document type, with voids accounted for.

features.name: Immutable audit log
features.description: Append-only log of every master change, override, discount, edit, return approval and settlement adjustment.
features.now: Most changes write an audit entry; the general audit log can still be edited by the system.
features.next: Make the audit log append-only and cover every important change.

features.name: Device, connectivity and peripheral rollout
features.description: Rugged device selection, mobile printer, scanner, data plan, MDM enrolment, spares pool, break-fix SLA, charging discipline in vans.
features.now: Printer and scanner support for the Senraise H10P and Bluetooth printers; no fleet register.
features.next: A device fleet register in the office, plus a rollout plan (devices, data, spares, charging).
features.laneWhen: Wave A, started 20 Oct (Integrity: fleet register; Programme: rollout plan)

features.name: Data cleansing and migration
features.description: Cleanse and migrate customer, outlet, route and open AR data.
features.now: Imports for products, opening stock and counts; not for customers, outlets or routes.
features.next: Add imports for customers, outlets, routes and open receivables, with duplicate checks.

features.name: Environment, release and cutover playbook
features.description: Dev, QA, staging, production.
features.now: Release and signing steps exist, but the playbook still describes the old setup.
features.next: Rewrite the release and cutover playbook for the current system, with test and live setups.

features.name: Location and device integrity controls
features.description: Mock-location detection, rooted device blocking, photo EXIF checks and travel-speed plausibility.
features.now: Fake-GPS and weak-signal checks on visits; no rooted-phone block or travel-speed check.
features.next: Block rooted or tampered phones, check impossible travel and check photo time and place.

features.name: Non-functional requirements baseline
features.description: Signed targets for sync SLA, offline duration, device spec, battery, data use and availability.
features.now: A draft of performance targets exists, not yet agreed.
features.next: A one-page list of targets (sync, offline day, battery, data, uptime, printing) for you to sign.

features.name: Van as a managed inventory location
features.description: Each van is a storage location in SAP.
features.now: Each van is a stock location in our system with its own stock value.
features.next: Map every van and depot to its SAP plant and storage location; SAP keeps the value.

features.name: Load plan generation
features.description: Suggest load per van from the day's beat, outlet class mix, last three cycles of offtake and open pre-sell orders.
features.now: Load lists are entered by hand.
features.next: Suggest the load per product from the route, outlet history and pending orders, for review.

features.name: Load-out scan and confirmation
features.description: Scan at case or pallet level into the van.
features.now: Load-out by barcode scan, by case or piece, with reasons for any difference.
features.next: Keep it and include it in the real-route test.

features.name: Real-time van stock ledger
features.description: Live position by SKU, batch and expiry.
features.now: Van stock is tracked by product only on the phone; batch and expiry are kept in the office.
features.next: Track batch and expiry on the van too, and sell the oldest batch first.

features.name: Trip lifecycle
features.description: Trip object: start, odometer, planned beat, actual sequence, end, closing odometer.
features.now: Trips link route, seller, van and day, with odometer at start.
features.next: Record every call in the trip and require closing odometer, or a reason if missing.

features.name: Geofenced check-in and check-out
features.description: Check-in only within a defined radius of the outlet geocode.
features.now: Field visits check location; the van app does not check the outlet location.
features.next: Check location at the start and end of every call in both apps; outside the radius needs a reason.

features.name: Van sales call flow
features.description: Configurable step sequence: check-in, stock check, order build, discount, invoice, payment, return pickup, evidence, check-out.
features.now: The van app follows fixed screens; the field app follows its own steps.
features.next: Run the van call through the shared call-flow engine with set, ordered steps.

features.name: On-truck order and invoice generation
features.description: Build order from van stock only.
features.now: Sale, payment and stock update are saved together offline on the van.
features.next: Add the sales-invoice link, frozen tax and price detail, document number and SAP posting status.

features.name: Compliant document printing
features.description: Print BIR-compliant Sales Invoice and OR on a mobile printer with controlled series and reprint control.
features.now: Receipts print offline with reprint tracking; numbers are not a controlled series.
features.next: Print with controlled document numbers and account for every voided or spoiled document.

features.name: Line and basket discount application (stub)
features.description: Apply approved discounts and simple schemes at line and basket level with authority limits.
features.now: Discount rules exist in the office, but the van refuses discounts.
features.next: Let the van apply approved discounts offline, with the same total on phone and server.
features.laneWhen: Wave B, next (van discounts, before the full scheme engine in Wave C)

features.name: Multi-tender capture
features.description: Cash, GCash, Maya, card, cheque.
features.now: Cash, cheque, GCash, bank transfer and credit, one tender per sale.
features.next: Allow split payment across tenders, add Maya and card, and show them in settlement.

features.name: Credit exposure check at order
features.description: Check available credit before confirming a credit sale.
features.now: Credit is worked out from orders in our system, not from SAP.
features.next: Ask SAP for the credit decision at order time; offline orders wait as provisional.

features.name: Sales return and bad order pickup
features.description: Capture returns at the outlet with one reason code set, quantity, batch, photo evidence and customer acknowledgement.
features.block: Returns, Bad Order and Reverse Logistics
features.now: Returns capture reason, quantity, batch and expiry, linked to the original sale.
features.next: Add photos and customer acknowledgement, and allow returns against older SAP invoices.

features.name: Returnable container and crate tracking
features.description: Track crates, trays and pallets issued to and returned from outlets.
features.now: No crate or container tracking.
features.next: Track crates and containers given and taken back per outlet and per van.

features.name: Temperature logging and cold chain evidence
features.description: Record van temperature at load-out, at defined intervals and at each delivery.
features.now: No temperature logging.
features.next: Log van temperature at set checkpoints, with alerts and reasons for excursions.

features.name: Load-in and unload reconciliation
features.description: End of trip: scan back unsold stock, returns and empties.
features.now: End-of-trip count with explained differences; stock goes back to the depot.
features.next: Split unload into unsold, customer returns and empties, by batch, with warehouse sign-off.

features.name: Van settlement and supervisor sign-off
features.description: Single settlement view: opening load plus reload, less sales, less returns, equals closing.
features.now: One office settlement screen for stock, cash, sales and returns.
features.next: Lock each settlement as a signed record with your settlement equation and supervisor sign-off.

features.name: Variance escalation and disposition
features.description: Variances above tolerance route to supervisor then area manager.
features.now: Cash and stock differences need one approval above a fixed limit.
features.next: Set limits by date; escalate from supervisor to area manager by size and time.

features.name: Real-time posting to SAP
features.description: Invoice, payment, goods movement, credit memo and settlement post to SAP on sync with full traceability and no manual re-keying.
features.now: Stock movements queue for SAP, but the SAP link is not connected to the new system.
features.next: Post invoices, returns, collections and stock moves to SAP as they happen, with SAP references back.

features.name: Zero-sale and no-order reason capture
features.description: If a call closes with no order, the seller must select a reason from a controlled list, with optional evidence.
features.now: No-order calls need a typed reason in the field app; the van has no call close.
features.next: A reason list picked at call close in both apps when no order was taken.

features.name: En-route replenishment request
features.description: Seller requests a reload when a fast mover depletes.
features.now: No mid-route reload request.
features.next: Request, approve, send and receive a reload during the trip, offline-safe.

features.name: Seller daily scorecard
features.description: Sales, calls, strike rate, drop size, returns, variance, collection.
features.now: Trip totals and daily calls, sales and collections are shown.
features.next: One seller daily scorecard with calls, order calls, drop size, sales and collections.

features.name: Full-trip offline operation
features.description: Complete a full trip with zero connectivity: sell, invoice, print, collect, return, settle locally.
features.now: Selling is fully offline, but closing the day needs a connection.
features.next: Allow counting and closing the day offline; the office completes settlement after sync.

features.name: Manual override with dual control
features.description: Every override, price, credit, stock, discount, void, requires a reason, a second approver above a threshold, and lands in the audit log.
features.now: Approvals by another person for voids, cash and stock; not for price changes.
features.next: Dual approval for all five override types, with a supervisor queue in the office.

features.name: Permanent journey plan builder
features.description: Assign visit frequency by outlet class, build beat cycles, balance workload, simulate before publishing.
features.block: Geography, Territory, Route and Beat Master
features.now: Monthly coverage plans per rep with outlet visit frequency.
features.next: A permanent journey plan built from beat cycles that generates each month's plan.

features.name: PJP publication and version control
features.description: Publish with effective dates.
features.block: Geography, Territory, Route and Beat Master
features.now: Plans have versions, approval and effective dates.
features.next: Keep it and use it for permanent journey plans too.

features.name: Daily agenda on device
features.description: Today's beat with sequence, outlet detail, last visit outcome, outstanding AR, MSL gaps and objectives per call.
features.now: Phones show the next three days of visits offline.
features.next: Add last visit, open receivables from SAP, missing MSL items and objectives to each stop.

features.name: Sequence enforcement and deviation reason
features.description: Visits follow planned sequence.
features.now: Visits must follow the planned order.
features.next: Allow a deviation with a reason, recorded for review.

features.name: Off-route and unplanned visit control
features.description: Unplanned outlets can be visited but are tagged, require a reason and are reported separately so they do not inflate adherence.
features.now: Unplanned visits need a reason and do not count toward the plan.
features.next: Add an offline outlet search within the rep's territory for unplanned visits.

features.name: PJP adherence measurement
features.description: Planned versus actual by rep, beat, day and territory.
features.now: Plan adherence by rep and territory, weekly.
features.next: Add adherence by beat and day, plus frequency achieved.

features.name: Time in store and call duration validation
features.description: Minimum dwell time per outlet class.
features.now: Call duration is recorded.
features.next: Minimum time in store by outlet class; flag short or doubtful calls.

features.name: Productive call definition and tracking
features.description: Explicit definition of a productive call, agreed by Sales and Trade Marketing.
features.now: A productive call counts any listed activity, as set on 2 October.
features.next: Adopt the definition you sign off, dated and applied to every visit the same way.

features.name: New outlet acquisition workflow
features.description: Rep registers a prospect with geo, photo and KYC.
features.now: New outlet proposal with photo, approval and a provisional outlet, from the office.
features.next: Let reps propose new outlets offline on the phone, with photo and KYC documents.

features.name: Dormancy and churn detection
features.description: Flag outlets with no purchase across a defined number of cycles.
features.now: Stores are labelled lost or dormant by comparing sales periods.
features.next: Detect dormancy by missed purchase cycles, with a recovery task.

features.name: MSL assignment engine
features.description: Assign MSL sets to outlets by channel, sub-channel and class.
features.now: Must-stock lists are set outlet by outlet.
features.next: Assign MSL lists automatically by channel and class, with preview and publish.

features.name: In-call availability check
features.description: Rep confirms presence or absence of each MSL line at the shelf, by scan or tap.
features.now: Shelf checks record availability per product.
features.next: An MSL checklist in each call: present, absent or not checked, by scan or tap.

features.name: Out-of-stock to order conversion
features.description: Any MSL line marked absent is proposed on the order line automatically.
features.now: Missing items are recorded but do not become an order.
features.next: Turn missing MSL items into a suggested order in the same call.

features.name: Numeric and weighted distribution computation
features.description: Numeric distribution as outlets stocking a SKU over universe.
features.now: “Distribution” today means stores that bought, not stores that stock.
features.next: Numeric and weighted distribution from shelf checks, as your spec defines it.

features.name: SKU per outlet and lines per call
features.description: Depth of distribution per outlet and productivity of each call in lines sold.
features.now: Lines per call and products bought per store are shown.
features.next: Show products stocked and products sold per outlet and lines per call, clearly defined.

features.name: New product distribution build tracker
features.description: For a defined launch: target outlet list, first-order date per outlet, build curve against plan, repeat purchase.
features.now: No new-product launch tracker.
features.next: Track launch products: target outlets, first order, repeat order and on-shelf by date.

features.name: Shelf stock and offtake capture
features.description: Capture on-shelf and back-room stock for key SKUs.
features.now: Beginning, delivered, offtake and ending stock can be captured.
features.next: Add shelf and back-room quantities for key products and work out offtake.

features.name: Rule-based suggested order
features.description: Suggest order from MSL gaps, derived offtake, days of cover, focus SKUs and open promotions.
features.now: Suggested order from history, stock and promotions, on the web.
features.next: One suggested-order service for web, field and van, including MSL gaps.

features.name: Focus SKU and objective push
features.description: Push priority SKUs and per-call objectives from head office to the device by territory, channel or outlet class.
features.now: Plans carry visit objectives; supervisors can add tasks.
features.next: Focus-product campaigns that turn into objectives on each call.

features.name: Coverage cockpit
features.description: Universe, covered universe, billed universe, coverage frequency achieved, adherence, strike rate, distribution.
features.now: A live coverage cockpit with plan, off-plan, productivity and time.
features.next: Add outlet universe, covered and billed outlets, with drill-down.

features.name: Field data integrity monitoring
features.description: Ongoing detection of mock location, impossible travel, duplicated photos, EXIF mismatch, batch check-ins.
features.now: Location checks and photo duplicate checks on visits.
features.next: Detect impossible travel, reused photos and bursts of check-ins.

features.name: Attendance and field time tracking
features.description: Geo and photo clock-in, first and last call times, in-field hours, absence and leave integration.
features.now: Work-day start and end, first and last calls are tracked.
features.next: Attendance with photo and location, breaks, corrections and leave import.

features.name: Supervisor joint call module
features.description: Structured work-with: observation checklist, coaching notes, agreed actions, follow-up at next joint call.
features.now: Work-with sessions, observations and coaching notes are built.
features.next: Add action items with owners and due dates, carried into the next session.

features.name: Territory and workload rebalancing
features.description: Simulate territory and beat changes against outlet count, potential and travel time.
features.block: Geography, Territory, Route and Beat Master
features.now: Workload per rep and territory is shown.
features.next: Try territory changes as drafts and see the effect before applying.

features.name: Pre-sell call flow
features.description: Order today for delivery on a defined day.
features.now: Field orders are taken in a visit; no requested delivery date.
features.next: Pre-sell as a setting of the shared call flow, with requested delivery date.
features.laneWhen: Wave A, started 20 Oct (Call flow engine); pre-sell setting in Wave B

features.name: Order to delivery handoff
features.description: Confirmed pre-sell orders release to the delivery plan.
features.now: Orders can be approved and posted; no hand-off to delivery.
features.next: Release confirmed orders to delivery and SAP.

features.name: Delivery scheduling and ePOD
features.description: Assign drops to trucks, sequence, driver manifest, delivery confirmation with signature, photo and geo stamp.
features.now: No delivery runs or proof of delivery.
features.next: Delivery runs, drop order and electronic proof of delivery with signature and photo.

features.name: Delivery variance and door rejection
features.description: Capture short delivery, rejection and damage at the door with reason and evidence.
features.block: Returns, Bad Order and Reverse Logistics
features.now: Van returns capture damage and reasons; no delivery-side refusals.
features.next: Record refused, short and damaged quantities at the door with reasons and photos.

features.name: Account hierarchy
features.description: Chain, banner, branch.
features.now: Customers are a flat list; outlets link to customers.
features.next: Chain, banner and branch hierarchy linked to SAP customers.

features.name: Purchase order intake
features.description: Ingest MT purchase orders by EDI, supplier portal, structured email or OCR depending on the account.
features.now: The office can type in a PO and create an order.
features.next: PO intake with the original document, product mapping and checks before confirming.

features.name: Trade terms and price list management
features.description: Account-specific price lists, listing fees, rebate terms, logistics allowances, with effective dates and approval.
features.block: Product, Pack, Price and MSL Master
features.now: Price lists by channel, not by account.
features.next: Account trade terms and price agreements with approval history.

features.name: Booking and delivery window compliance
features.description: Manage delivery appointments, arrival windows and unloading slots.
features.now: Outlets have a free-text visit window.
features.next: Delivery bookings and receiving windows per account.

features.name: Deduction and chargeback capture
features.description: Capture account deductions at remittance, classify by type, link to the underlying claim or dispute, and age them.
features.now: No deduction capture.
features.next: Capture account deductions and chargebacks against invoices, with disputes.

features.name: Merchandiser call flow
features.description: Execution-only visit: check-in, availability, planogram, POSM, price check, competitor, issue log, check-out.
features.now: Field visits have configurable activities and a merchandising check.
features.next: A merchandiser setting of the shared call flow: MSL, planogram, POSM, price, competitor.
features.laneWhen: Wave A, started 20 Oct (Call flow engine); merchandiser setting in Wave B

features.name: Planogram and share of shelf
features.description: Target planogram per outlet class.
features.now: Facings and share of shelf can be recorded.
features.next: Planogram templates by class and channel, checked in store.

features.name: Watermarked photo capture
features.description: All execution photos carry geo, timestamp, user and outlet watermark.
features.now: Photos carry visit, user, outlet and time details, but no visible stamp.
features.next: A visible watermark with place, time, user and outlet on every photo.

features.name: POSM deployment and audit
features.description: POSM catalogue, issue to field, deploy at outlet with photo, periodic audit of presence and condition, write-off.
features.now: Photos can support display checks; no POSM tracking.
features.next: POSM catalogue, issue, deployment and audit per outlet.

features.name: Freezer and chiller register
features.description: Asset register for company-owned cold equipment at outlets: serial, model, deployment date, custodian, agreement, location, service history.
features.now: No freezer or chiller register.
features.next: A register of freezers and chillers at outlets, linked to SAP assets.

features.name: Freezer purity and temperature audit
features.description: Scan the asset, photograph contents, record own-product share and temperature, flag agreement breaches.
features.now: Only a general freezer-placement check.
features.next: Freezer audits for purity, temperature and photo.

features.name: Perfect store scorecard
features.description: Weighted composite index: availability, planogram, POSM, price compliance, freezer purity, promotion execution.
features.now: Shelf checks count missing MSL items; no overall score.
features.next: A perfect store score with weighted parts you can see.

features.name: Competitor capture
features.description: Structured capture of competitor price, promotion, new SKU, display and share of shelf.
features.now: Competitor price and promotion notes can be saved.
features.next: Add competitor products and displays, captured offline on the phone.

features.name: In-store promotion compliance
features.description: Per-campaign checklist by outlet: display present, price correct, POSM up, stock sufficient.
features.now: Promotion checks are recorded against a typed program name.
features.next: Campaign checklists sent to the outlets they apply to.

features.name: Agency portal and billing evidence
features.description: Third-party agency view of attendance, visit completion, compliance and issues for their own staff only.
features.now: No agency portal.
features.next: An agency portal with their staff, contracts and evidence-backed billing.

features.name: Expiry and near-expiry shelf audit
